tagline: 美能达胶片相机，1984 年发布
description: 美能达于1984年推出的胶片相机。配备35 mm f/2,8 (4 elements/3 groups). 40,5 mm filter thread.。快门速度1/8–1/625 s.。使用Automatic loading, advance and rewind.。感光度Manually set at range of ISO 25–1000.。Active autofocus, 0,85 m to infinity.。

specs.镜头: 35 mm f/2,8 (4 elements/3 groups). 40,5 mm filter thread.
specs.曝光测光: Programmed exposure from EV 6 (1/8 s, f/2,8) to EV 17 (1/625, f/14,5).
specs.感光度: Manually set at range of ISO 25–1000.
specs.闪光灯: Built-in, max range at ISO 100 4,80 m. Out of range warning with beep and LED in finder. X synchronisation at 1/40 s.

A compact autofocus camera released around 1984, the Minolta AF-S is basically an AF-Sv (Talker) without the voice chip (or the other way around), with the other difference being a blue line on the right side instead of a red line.
